title: Primitives
description: Shared primitive types. Monetary values and prices are decimal strings; integers never exceed 2^53-1 so that every language (including JavaScript) represents them exactly; timestamps are UTC.

UtcTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time in UTC with a trailing 'Z'.

Price.description: Non-negative decimal string, up to 13 integer and 6 fractional digits.

Quantity.description: Non-negative decimal string, up to 15 integer and 4 fractional digits.

SignedQuantity.description: Signed decimal string (negative for short positions).

Money.description: Non-negative monetary decimal string, up to 15 integer and 4 fractional digits.

Rate.description: Signed decimal rate in percent (e.g. an annualized borrow fee).

SafeCount.description: Non-negative integer within the exactly representable range of IEEE-754 doubles.

Identifier.description: Opaque identifier (e.g. broker order id, client order id).
